T.data_reference: lynch2015bioenergetic; operating point 20 C, the temperature Lynch & Marinov normalise maintenance costs to

ATP.data_reference: bennett2009absolute; glucose-fed, exponentially growing E. coli: ATP 9.6 mM

ADP.data_reference: bennett2009absolute; glucose-fed, exponentially growing E. coli: ADP 0.56 mM (Table 1)

Pi.data_reference: amin1995dual; cytoplasmic Pi of E. coli near 10 mM in typical growth (BioNumbers BNID 105540, from Amin & Peterkofsky 1995 and Rao & Torriani 1994); 20-30 mM in carbon-starved cells

A_mem.data_reference: geometry: in-plane membrane of the 2 um cell

surface_factor.data_reference: geometry: a disc of radius 1 um and depth 2 um has 1.5x its in-plane area as surface

n_mRNA.data_reference: derived: mRNA_per_um3 x cell volume (mRNA_per_um3: milo2010bionumbers, sourced)

L_mRNA.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; mean mRNA length about 1,000 nt

t_half_mRNA.data_reference: bernstein2002global; 80% of E. coli mRNA half-lives 3-8 min (median ~5 min)

n_ribo.data_reference: derived: ribosomes_per_um3 x cell volume (ribosomes_per_um3: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder)

c_nt_denovo.data_reference: lynch2015bioenergetic; of order 50 ~P per nucleotide made from glucose

area_per_lipid.data_reference: milo2010bionumbers; BNID 106993: about 0.5 nm2 per lipid

c_lipid.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; two C16 acyl chains (ATP and NADPH counted as ~P) plus head group: ~100 ~P per phospholipid

genome_nt.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; an E. coli-sized genome, 4.6 Mb, both strands

K_m_ATP_bio.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; polymerase and synthetase ATP affinity, order 0.1 mM

ATP_ref.data_reference: bennett2009absolute; glucose-fed, exponentially growing E. coli: ATP 9.6 mM

T_ref_dmg.data_reference: lynch2015bioenergetic; operating point 20 C, the temperature Lynch & Marinov normalise maintenance costs to

dT_Q10.data_reference: definitional; definition of Q10 (rate ratio per 10 K)

Cai.data_reference: gangola1987maintenance; free cytosolic Ca2+ in E. coli 90 +- 10 nM

K_Ca_dmg.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; Ca2+ damages ribosomes as it approaches the free Mg2+ (1-2 mM), which holds them together

Ki.data_reference: milo2010bionumbers; BNID 107114: E. coli cytosolic K+ 180-200 mM

K_K_dmg.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; ribosomes need ~100 mM K+ to translate; below it they lose structure

ATP_dmg.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; below ~1 mM ATP chaperones and disaggregases stop keeping proteins folded

k_lipid_dmg.data_reference: derived: k_lipid / lipid_damage_lethal_fraction (k_lipid: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder; lipid_damage_lethal_fraction: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder)

R_reg_maint.data_reference: definitional; no maintenance ATPase connected (nothing cut)

J_ATP_ribo_in.data_reference: calibrated: the resting ribosomes' rRNA upkeep (cell/ribosomes at rest), used when unconnected

dose_rate.data_reference: definitional; no radiation by default (natural background, ~1e-10 Gy/s, is negligible)

k_rad_dmg.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; a lethal load at 300 Gy: E. coli's D10 for gamma rays is ~0.14-0.7 kGy (Deinococcus radiodurans ~10 kGy)

r_rep_max.data_reference: derived: repair_capacity_ratio / damage_lifetime (repair_capacity_ratio: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder; damage_lifetime: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder)

K_D.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; repair is half-maximal at a tenth of a lethal load

C_repair.data_reference: derived: repair_cost_fraction x the daughter's itemised cost (repair_cost_fraction: unreferenced_placeholder, placeholder)

growth_level.data_reference: definitional; no growth until the player puts energy into it

J_ref.data_reference: derived: maintenance_coefficient x cell volume ^ maintenance_exponent (maintenance_coefficient: lynch2015bioenergetic, sourced; maintenance_exponent: lynch2015bioenergetic, sourced)

ATP_floor.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; ATP at which building protein and growth stop (stringent response); full speed at the resting ATP

M_build_in.data_reference: no pool connected (an open sum port is 0)

D_phys_init.data_reference: definitional; no physical damage at start

D_rad_init.data_reference: definitional; no radiation damage at start

D_ribo_init.data_reference: calibrated: steady wear at full repair

D_energy_init.data_reference: definitional; no de-energisation damage at start
